title: Anwendung / Schriftfarbe und Zeilenabstand
slide_intent: Control contrast and line spacing so readers can distinguish letters and follow lines without effort.
strategic_value: Consistent reading conditions can let DB typography work across plain and photographic surfaces.
demonstration: Four Aa specimens compare black and white on plain and photographic backgrounds; two diagrams and lists define line-height multipliers.
practical_value: Choose black or white for contrast, then apply the multiplier appropriate to functional or promotional text.

content_islands.name: Color examples
content_islands.spec: Arrange four Aa specimens in a two-by-two comparison with captions.

content_islands.name: Spacing rules
content_islands.spec: Place functional and promotional examples above their separate line-height lists.

reference_purposes.Application: The source provides four color/background examples and numerical line-height rules.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Functional headings use 1.1× and body 1.3×; promotional capitals use 1.0×, umlauts or mixed case 1.1×, and body 1.3×.

ingredient.name: DB typography contrast and leading
ingredient.application: Default to White or Black (#000000); select for contrast on photographs. Use the stated line-height multipliers.
ingredient.scope: Official DB new-design website captured 2026-11-05; edition date unstated. Functional heading 1.1×; body 1.3×. Promotional capitals 1.0×, umlauts/mixed case 1.1×, body 1.3×.
